community_list_entries.name: EMBODIED AGENTS MEET PERSONALIZATION: INVESTIGATING CHALLENGES AND SOLUTIONS THROUGH THE LENS OF MEMORY UTILIZATION

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A two-stage embodied evaluation framework built on Habitat/PARTNR. In the memory-acquisition stage the agent completes episodes; in the utilization stage it gets underspecified instructions with single- and joint-memory tasks. It tests recall of personal object semantics and user behavioral routines
